verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud lists 'Built-in Sales Flows and Lead Routing' and markets automation of the sales cycle, and Agent Builder references existing Flows as an asset. A community user also reports building a timed email in SFDC within minutes, which is the product's own workflow automation. However, the pack never documents trigger conditions, record-update actions, task creation, or notification steps specifically. missing for 10: documented trigger types (record-change/scheduled), explicit record-update and task-creation actions, notification action docs, hands-on corroboration of a full trigger-to-action workflow.
